name: AUDD
oneLiner: AUDD is AUDC Pty Ltd's centralized Australian dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 and backed by AUD cash and Treasury bills at regulated Australian banks.
collateral: Australian dollar cash and cash equivalents, including Treasury bills and notes, held in segregated accounts at Australian Authorised Deposit-taking Institutions by AUDC Pty Ltd
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for AUD through AUDC Pty Ltd (AFSL No. 700123, Novatti subsidiary), with monthly independent reserve attestations by William Buck

applicabilityBasis.summary: AUDD is a 1:1 AUD-backed payment stablecoin with institutional redemption, multichain distribution, and Coinbase Wallet custody availability for US users (trading restricted to non-US Coinbase users).

genius.notes: AUDD is a foreign non-USD payment stablecoin with some US presence (Coinbase Wallet custody; not tradable on Coinbase for US-based users). No GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or foreign-issuer exception registration found. Foreign exception framework still under proposed rulemaking (Treasury NPRM FR 2026-06489). Monthly William Buck attestations confirmed through May 2026.

references.label: Coinbase AUDD listing blog (global, not US trading)
AUDD transparency (monthly William Buck attestations through May 2026)

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin 2026-3 and public releases

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public US GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception was located for AUDD. Foreign exception registration framework remains in proposed-rulemaking phase as of 2026-06-07.

reserves.name: AUD cash & Treasury bills at ADIs

mintAuthority.summary: AUDD is issued by AUDC Pty Ltd (Novatti, AFSL 700123); minting and 1:1 AUD redemption run through the issuer's centralized backend against segregated AUD cash and Treasury bills at Australian ADIs.

controls.label: AUDC Pty Ltd issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: AUDC Pty Ltd creates and redeems AUDD supply 1:1 against custodied AUD reserves; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists across its native multichain deployments.

review.evidence: AUDD whitepaper and transparency materials describe a single regulated issuer (AUDC Pty Ltd / Novatti) minting against off-chain AUD reserves with William Buck attestations. Ethereum and Base EVM chains confirmed: EOA token owners and EOA-owned proxy admins verified via owner() and EIP-1967 admin slot reads at blocks 25295029/47200702.
unresolvedQuestions: Non-EVM chains (Stellar, XRPL, Solana, Hedera, Redbelly) and XDC mint authority not confirmed; multiple distinct EOA owners across chains raises cross-chain posture question before promoting to verified.
